Perthro — Rune Meaning

← All rune meanings
ᛈ
mystery the unknown hidden things fate

Upright meaning

Perthro is the mystery rune. There's something going on beneath the surface that you can't fully see yet, and that's okay. Not everything reveals itself on your timeline.

Sit with the uncertainty for a bit instead of forcing an answer. This rune also invites you to look inward — there might be something you've been avoiding knowing about yourself, a feeling or desire you haven't let yourself name.

Whatever is hidden right now will become clear eventually. You don't have to figure it all out today.

Reversed meaning

Reversed Perthro suggests that the hidden stuff isn't just mysterious — it's being actively concealed, maybe by someone else, maybe by your own avoidance.

Are you avoiding looking at something because you're afraid of what you'll find? That kind of avoidance doesn't protect you; it just leaves you making decisions without all the information.

Stop hoping luck will fix what needs direct action. If you need to know something, go find it out.
